bundle.shortDescription: DEV10 HEX Plugins and six-core installer; not a LIVE release
bundle.longDescription: HEX DEV10 packages the new Plugins category and existing six-product installer within the original native window. The installer is fail-closed until six exact owner-published payloads and a qualified core-release lock are available and approved. Installing HEX alone does not enroll devices, grant Ward authority, start remote services or authorize ChatGPT.
